verdict.rationale: NotebookLM supports exporting notes to Google Docs and Google Sheets, covering document and spreadsheet formats, but there is no evidence of reference-manager export (e.g., BibTeX, RIS, Zotero/EndNote formats) which researchers typically need for citations. missing for 10: reference-manager export formats (BibTeX/RIS/Zotero), broader export options beyond Docs/Sheets, independent corroboration of export fidelity.
